title: Verify the delivered Anthropic connector aggregate

outcomes.statement: The Anthropic connector aggregate is closed from traceable verification of the canonical US-056, US-057, and US-058 deliveries, without duplicating their implementation.
outcomes.demo: Four timestamped AC verifications cite the official child evidence, the current repository build passes once, no application or package code changes, and the terminal US-018 event unblocks US-019.

uncertainties.statement: Whether closing the aggregate requires any new connector implementation.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-052 establishes verification-only closure. US-056 delivers AC1, US-057 delivers AC2, and US-058 delivers AC3 and AC4. No application, package, migration, runtime, test, or executable-tooling change is allowed.

uncertainties.statement: Whether parent verification requires another authoritative mutation campaign.
uncertainties.resolution: The canonical children retain their own mutation evidence, this assessment changes no mutatable source and declares zero mutation shards. Run no cold campaign unless evidence inspection identifies a genuine new need, and never more than one.

uncertainties.statement: How to preserve provenance when older US-056 and US-057 lifecycle evidence predates the timestamp contract.
uncertainties.resolution: Do not rewrite or pretend timestamps for historical child events. Cite their immutable source commits and committed feedback lines, while every newly emitted US-018 lifecycle and verification event carries an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.

controlling_change.reason: CHG-052 converts the aggregate from duplicate implementation into evidence-only closure over the delivered canonical children.
